prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: orthographic game texture-source painting, flat albedo, 1024 x 1024 RGBA PNG with genuinely transparent background.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the exact orthographic model guide for this view. Input image 2 is the MATERIAL/DESIGN REFERENCE ONLY: approved art of Aster's memory shard. Paint only the existing surfaces of input image 1. Its alpha silhouette, every part edge, occupied pixels, scale, placement, faceting, camera and occlusion order are immutable. Preserve the original 1024 x 1024 canvas and every transparent pixel. Do not recenter, enlarge, rotate, reshape, connect gaps or add geometry. Do not reproduce the reference's diagonal perspective.
Materials: paint the guide's pale blue crystal surfaces with the design reference's cool clear icy blue crystal, subtle fine internal cracks, small inclusions and delicate branching blue-white memory filaments. These filaments are bright coloured paint, with no bloom or light spill. Paint the guide's light grey ceramic component as worn ivory-white ceramic panels with fine seams, narrow brushed antique-gold trim and small non-letter engraved lines. Carry the reference's black-violet resin with subtle organic engraved swirls along appropriate crystal edges as surface paint INSIDE the existing silhouette; never make new protrusions. Gold is muted gold base colour with only a faint sheen. Continue hidden surfaces plausibly in the same material palette. Do not add leather, fabric, paper, orange light or other materials absent from this reference.
Lighting: entirely flat, even, shadowless illumination from the viewer, for albedo projection. No cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no directional light gradient, no strong specular highlights or reflections, no white glints, no rim light. Crystal remains blue material colour, not a rendered mirror. Fine wear and seams are surface colours, not deeply shadowed relief.
Background must be real transparency, no floor, no backdrop, no checkerboard painted into pixels. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, border, extra objects or labels. Deliver just ONE painted view, unresized, not a sheet. Exact guide geometry is the highest priority.
VIEW GEOMETRY: FRONT view. Keep the narrow horizontal foreshortened silhouette in the exact guide region x=229..794, y=426..597, with abundant unchanged transparency around it. The crystal spans horizontally behind the central octagonal ceramic end cap: blunt faceted crystal on the left, pointed faceted crystal to the right. The central ceramic cap, roughly x=407..586, remains in front of the crystals, with its small central polygon retained as a ceramic panel. No upright V-shape in this view.
